objective: Reconcile verified referral and Economy data with canonical signup identity, member-scoped destination selection and Organization-specific Cluster messaging without payouts or unrelated changes.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: BUKLOD-Rork GitHub main SHA 66b3eefaeae7f9f136a98fdef08e1cba2ecfb742 at integration start; on 2026-11-15 Supabase read-only audit confirmed code mismatch, QMP parity, Official referral guard and all Finance payout gates disabled. Dry-run SQL transaction ROLLBACK, no production migration applied or OTA published.
chosenApproach: Small additive Finance RPC for verified idempotent referral attribution and authenticated Community Destination, replace suggestion-only display RPC with canonical Finance code, nonpaying historical provenance backfill, correct scoped UI and preserve runtime 1.3.2.
selectionRationale: Prevents wrong referrer locks, avoids legacy-code divergence for 356 accounts, corrects misleading Organization-specific Cluster state while keeping existing membership and monetary protections intact.
alternativeApproaches: Rewrite all legacy referral codes in place (rejected: would invalidate old invitation links).
Automatically convert all historical referrals into payouts (rejected: violates Finance qualification and BUKLOD Official guard).
Rebuild native Android to resolve presentation mismatches (rejected: no native dependency change).
preserveBehaviors: Historical invitation counts and 8-character aliases remain usable; no reassignment to another referrer.
One-time ₱20 and 10%/six-month referral policy requires real qualification; no automatic credit.
Official member referral financial restrictions remain enforced on client and backend.
30% QMP user-pool points unchanged, no AdMob source or cash ledger mutation.
Cluster membership remains scope-specific, not silently transferred between Organizations.
System Admin, data permissions, unrelated ads/media/PTT and runtime 1.3.2 unchanged.
Legacy-only active profiles without Finance mapping remain discoverable, but historical attribution alone is never withdrawable.
acceptanceChecks: Canonical suggestion returns 7BF347319E for Biboy and never 48680BC3; legacy code still resolves.
Wrong-referrer duplicate request denied; original referrer retry succeeds idempotently.
Qualified Finance identity only for historic pending records with original timestamps, matching profiles, non-Official participants; no money credited.
Personal 195 QMP and total 2758 QMP unchanged.
Organization shows zero in-scope Cluster while permitting access to five existing Clusters elsewhere.
No Community designation selected unless user explicitly chooses eligible membership; switch lock enforced.
SQL contract plus auth/finance/scope JS tests and Engineering Accountability pass.
All payouts/finance flags stay OFF, staging before any production release.
Unlinked older accounts remain discoverable with an explicit pending-identity message and can record a historical-only attribution without making up money.
